recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit for core reconciliation. If the extension definition's range prose or constraints need future adjustment, make that follow-up in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than in core.
issue_request: FHIR-13558 was a Published FHIR-core STU3 change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to consider adding dayOfMonth, 0..*, integer, range 1 to 31 to Timing.repeat; the accepted resolution was to define this as a standard extension.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites svn revision 12465. Git commit 12ab1356c540c7cb59b480b1a0a5cce7f2167505 mirrors that revision and added the dayOfMonth standard extension to source/datatypes/timing-extensions-spreadsheet.xml in core.
additional_context: Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed extension definitions from the R5 core source, including timing-dayOfMonth. The current FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-timing-dayOfMonth.xml with canonical URL http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/timing-dayOfMonth and context Timing.repeat. Current core source uses the extension in dosage examples and does not define a native Timing.repeat.dayOfMonth element.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. The issue was decided as external-repo because the resolved artifact is currently maintained outside the core FHIR checkout, and re-adding it to core would conflict with the extension-source migration.
